name: Kurayashiki Akiko
source:
[b]“I’m not going back home until [url=/c9702/]Kaito[/url] comes along with us!”[/b]

Akiko is [url=/c9705/]Tae[/url]’s mother. She’s 42 years old, though she acts more childish than her age would suggest—Whenever things don’t go her way she makes a habit of throwing terrible temper tantrums. 

She’s also the president of Kurayashiki Industries, as well as the engineer who created [url=/c20144/]Yuuki[/url], her first sentient android.

Hobbies: Whenever she has some free time for herself, Akiko likes gardening.
Likes: Cleanliness, and pretty boys.
Dislikes: Whatever lacks technological advancement.

[From [url=https://daybreaktl.wordpress.com/projectoverview/meet-the-characters]Daybreak Translations[/url]]
